onboarding.title: Get your first signal in three steps
onboarding.description: The dashboard fills in once we have something to track. Take five minutes now and you'll have live competitor data, a price recommendation, and an AI brief by the time you're done.
onboarding.autoUpdate: This card updates on its own as you complete each step.

step1.title: Add your first competitor product
step1.body: Save a product URL from one competitor. Carrefour, Lulu, Talabat, anything you sell against.

step2.title: Run your first live scrape
step2.body: Pull a real price from the URL you saved. Takes about ten seconds.

step3.title: Generate your first AI read
step3.body: Let the model summarise what just landed and recommend a move.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: AI-driven price recommendations with explainable reasoning and projected margin impact.
pricing.help1: Each card explains why the model recommends a new price, plus the expected unit and monthly impact.
pricing.help2: Confidence reflects how strong the underlying signals are. Review the low-confidence ones manually.
pricing.help3: Pricing rules at the bottom constrain the model. Toggle them to enforce floors, parity, and other guardrails.
